candidates.name: cache-references
candidates.meaning: Kernel generic cache references; cache level, prefetch and request scope are CPU/kernel dependent.

candidates.name: l2d_cache
candidates.meaning: L2 cache accesses; proxy for cache references.

candidates.name: cache-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel generic cache misses; not guaranteed to be demand-load or LLC misses.

candidates.name: l2d_cache_refill_rd
candidates.meaning: L2 read refills including store allocation; proxy for cache misses.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-loads
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D read-access mapping; speculative versus retired scope must be checked per CPU.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D read-miss mapping; may count refills rather than retired misses.

candidates.name: l1d_cache_refill_rd
candidates.meaning: L1D line allocations caused by speculative load misses.

candidates.name: L1-dcache-stores
candidates.meaning: Kernel L1D write-access mapping; the read-only kernel should have little store activity.

candidates.name: LLC-loads
candidates.meaning: Kernel last-level read-access mapping; do not assume identical LLC domains across CPUs.

candidates.name: ll_cache_rd
candidates.meaning: Last-level read event; EXTLLC/firmware dependent. Existing 8.3 results did NOT validate SLC boundary.

candidates.name: LLC-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel last-level read-miss mapping; interpretation depends on CPU and firmware.

candidates.name: ll_cache_miss_rd
candidates.meaning: Last-level read miss event; existing 8.3 results track L2 refills, NOT verified SLC misses.

candidates.name: dTLB-load-misses
candidates.meaning: Kernel data-TLB read-miss mapping; may mean page walks rather than L1 TLB misses.

candidates.name: l1d_tlb_refill
candidates.meaning: L1D TLB refills, including speculative activity; not page walks.
